labels.variantDefinition: An interactive infographic on the font's theme (line-ups, stats, timetables) set in the family, so labels, numerals and UI type do real work
labels.look: Yellow field, teal 'Classic line-ups', year crests, player list, green pitch with numbered pins, player card with stats; cookie banner partly over it
labels.ux: Pick a year to load that team's line-up; players and stats update
labels.learn: Build a small data toy around the font's subject: numerals, tables and labels get shown in real UI without a 'feature' section

labels.variantDefinition: Numbered 'Fig.' diagrams (often animated, sticky) of letterform details beside short captions, one design decision per figure, like a technical paper
labels.look: Capture shows an overlapping sticky A–Z word list (ANATOMY…ZONE) in grey serif caps; the Fig. 7/8 Lottie diagrams did not render
labels.ux: Scroll-driven sticky Lottie figures with captions on slant angle and italic design
labels.learn: Number design decisions as figures: it frames type design as considered engineering and makes each point citable

labels.look: White, black serif bold role labels with underlined names (design, illustrations, writing, thanks), copyright line
labels.learn: Credit writers and illustrators like a magazine masthead: it signals the specimen is a real publication

labels.variantDefinition: A playful maker: the visitor combines illustrated parts or backdrops with their own text in a chosen style, then shares or downloads the image
labels.look: Navy page, white card with a dense line-drawn animal chimera, up/down arrows each side, style picker 'a a a a', 'Place your text here'
labels.ux: Arrows swap animal halves, type up to 35 characters, pick a style, share or download
labels.learn: Give the tester an output worth sharing: a personalised artwork spreads the typeface further than a sample line

labels.variantDefinition: The character set set as running lines of text at display size (A–Z, a–z, other scripts), filling the width, no cells or labels
labels.look: Dark grey, white and light-grey ultra-condensed caps and lowercase, then Greek and Cyrillic, alternating row tints, full width
labels.learn: Alternate row tints so a dense alphabet set solid still reads line by line

labels.look: Sea-teal gradient waves, line-drawn fish, pill toggles (FRACTIONS ON, TABULAR NUMBERS OFF…) above themed samples
labels.ux: Toggle each feature (frac, tnum, sups, case, subs, onum) on its own sample
labels.learn: Give every OpenType feature a themed real-world sample (surf height, tide table, salinity) so its purpose is obvious

labels.variantDefinition: Real words from many languages chosen for their accents and special letters, set at display size to prove coverage
labels.look: White between magenta bands, fat black blobby display: lowercase words left, caps words right (kêrel, grüßen, ZƏFƏR, MAĦFRA)
labels.learn: Pick words that each stress a different diacritic or special letter: coverage proven with no language table

labels.look: White, black uppercase A–Z as images in a 6-column grid, wide spacing; some letters missing (lazy-load gaps)
labels.learn: Generous spacing around each capital echoes an eye-test chart, tying the glyph set to the font's origin

labels.variantDefinition: One in-use mockup at a time (poster over a photo scene); a Randomize button shuffles artwork and backdrop combinations
labels.look: Black, rounded grey architecture photo with a dark poster of outlined 'FRAGMENT' letters on top, small RANDOMIZE button
labels.ux: Click Randomize to swap poster and background; sticky section
labels.learn: A randomize button turns a fixed set of mockups into something the visitor plays with and keeps clicking
